doctrineFindings.summary: Canonical creator/user route matrix is documented.
Conflicting creator settings, followers, raw id, public discovery, and dashboard stacking doctrine is absent.

routeFindings.summary: Creator dashboard, creator settings, account settings, and profile route constants are canonical.
/dashboard remains the normal user dashboard and redirects creator-role accounts.

navFindings.summary: Visible nav uses canonical route constants without duplicate account settings literals.
Account menus label USER_SETTINGS_ROUTE as Account Settings.

crmFindings.summary: Fan Pass CRM uses hydrated readable fan identity and hides raw ids.
Broadcast UI and route expose the explicit supported Followers audience.
Creator-facing broadcast copy excludes legacy all_fans and misleading broad-audience language.
Creator Dashboard uses one compact overview module.

backendFindings.summary: Subscriber API redacts private identity fields in normal creator responses.
Unsupported broadcast audiences fail with a human-safe validation error.

fixesApplied: Consolidated account menu settings links on USER_SETTINGS_ROUTE.
Marked the creator landing route with data-dashboard-surface="creator_dashboard".
Aligned creator broadcast copy and markers to the supported Followers audience.
Locked route, nav, CRM, broadcast, and dashboard boundary doctrine into a single consolidation report.
nextFixOrder: Run deterministic UI source coverage for /dashboard/creator and account nav; use browser reproduction only if it reports a concrete navigation issue.
Keep future creator dashboard additions route-scoped and update this consolidation validator when adding new creator nav destinations.
